subject.title: fix(ci): script-only changes cold-start every Node job

question: Should this protected CI cache-contract change merge before a direct v2 warm-hit can be observed only after the first protected writer publishes its marker?
rationale: The submitted hosted run demonstrates the timeout-and-retry recovery path, while the central warm-reuse assertion is blocked by the repository's protected cache trust boundary; choosing to accept monitored post-merge proof is a maintainer release-risk decision.

options.title: Require a protected warm-hit proof first
options.body: Use an approved trusted cache-writer or staging lane to capture an exact-head script-only run that skips pnpm install before merging.

options.title: Accept monitored rollout proof
options.body: Merge after rebase with the existing semantic coverage and cold-transition evidence, then verify the first protected writer and subsequent consumer immediately.

options.title: Pause the cache-key rewrite
options.body: Keep the existing broad fingerprint until a reproducible protected warm-hit validation lane is available.

recommendation.title: Require a protected warm-hit proof first
recommendation.body: Use an approved trusted cache-writer or staging lane to capture an exact-head script-only run that skips pnpm install before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned author has the most direct context on the cache-writer trust boundary and the proposed rollout evidence.
